verificationLimits: Original serialized source and independent calculator bindings are retained; tests establish adapter behavior, not recorded-client frame parity or recovered executable C# dispatch.

Liskarm RandomAlly selector has ignoreTargetFree1 and ignoreHealFree1, but no serialized ignoreAllyTargetFree; isolation exclusion is conservative, native profession/category and random dispatch are not recovered.
Liskarm first-attack opening reset on loss of target/control follows source onlyPlayBeginAnimWhenFirstAttack1; original Unity FSM reengagement and Skill_Down presentation are not fully reproduced.

Normal/source waitForAttackEvent uses parsed model events; Hoshiguma normal preDelay.2 is retained as an unused fallback under event-first interpretation. Instant stat casts use the shared skill lifecycle; exact original BuffAbility dispatch/cast animation frame is not certified.

Hoshiguma S3 triggerDelta1 and independent sec calculator support fixed1s pulses. Native continuous-attack predelay/pause/restart/postDelayChecker .8 C# behavior remains unrecovered; adapter skips controlled pulses and does not accumulate missed damage.

Source ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE to Cold/stun and ON_ABILITY_SPELL_ON to self heal are mapped to actual generic release callbacks; attack cancellation and one-output-versus-per-victim behavior are tested, native buff ordering across multiple original action controllers is not certified.
Modules, Unity effects/audio/FSM and stage-specific systems not explicitly listed remain unsupported; these kits do not claim full recorded-client parity.
